title: Fiscal Policy Can Help Broaden the Gains of AI to Humanity
publisher: Era Dabla-Norris and Ruud de Mooij / IMF
locator: Social protection; Tax policy; Broader implications
evidence_type: Official policy summary, relevant sections inspected; underlying staff note not fully reviewed.
appraisal: Supports considering capital taxation and protection during transitions; warns against a specific AI tax. Policy analysis does not prove that a generous universal transfer is affordable.

title: Unconditional Cash Study
locator: About the study; participant counts and transfer; Employment; Agency
appraisal: The same experiment as S04, not replication. Reports increased agency alongside modest reductions in work. Study-team framing and an older hosted paper must be distinguished from later NBER revisions.

title: General equilibrium effects of cash transfers: experimental evidence from Kenya
publisher: Dennis Egger, Johannes Haushofer, Edward Miguel, Paul Niehaus and Michael Walker
locator: PDF pp. 1, 4, 22–23 and 38–39; section 3.4.1 and conclusion
appraisal: Randomized local transfers produced spending gains and minimal local price inflation. External funding, local slack, trade and one-time payments constrain extrapolation to permanent national UHI. Coauthor Niehaus co-founded implementing charity GiveDirectly; later published estimates differ from this version.

title: Fund Structure
locator: Generating Earnings; Principal; How are Realized Earnings Used?
appraisal: Shows a real institution linking invested public wealth to services and resident dividends. Resource endowment and legislative rules differ from a prospective AI fund; dividends are not a high-income guarantee.

title: How might generative AI impact different occupations?
locator: Task scoring; What is the possible effect of generative AI on employment?
appraisal: Occupational task exposure is potential, not observed job destruction; infrastructure and adoption matter. Contemporary GenAI scope cannot establish or refute all-capable future AGI.

title: Elon Musk at Davos 2026: why technology could shape a more abundant future
locator: AI and robotics’ potential for economic growth; Energy needs
evidence_type: Event organizer account inspected; standalone podcast page exposed no transcript.
appraisal: Evidence of Musk’s publicly presented vision and its conditions, not empirical support for his predictions. Event organizer is primary for its event account; commercial speaker interests remain relevant.

title: 5.3 Juta Penerima STR Mula Terima Bayaran Secara Berperingkat Mulai Hari Ini
publisher: Ministry of Finance Malaysia / Bernama statement report
locator: Paragraphs on Phase 3 recipients, RM15bn annual allocation and bank/BSN channels
evidence_type: Primary programme/public record or institution’s own assessment; relevant passages inspected
appraisal: Official hosting of attributed programme data; phased payments and a mixed beneficiary-unit count are not a headcount of every person covered. Allocation is not actual outturn.

title: SARA Untuk Semua Disalurkan Mulai 9 Februari 2026
locator: Opening: RM2.2bn, over 22m adult citizens, RM100 one-off
evidence_type: Primary programme/public record or institution’s own assessment; relevant passages inspected
appraisal: Launch announcement establishes programme design and intended eligibility; it does not itself establish that every eligible person transacted.

title: Dewan Rakyat Hansard, 5 February 2026
publisher: Parliament of Malaysia; government minister’s response
locator: Printed p.2, PDF p.10: 2025 usage rates and monthly transaction value/allocation
evidence_type: Primary programme/public record or institution’s own assessment; relevant passages inspected
appraisal: Downloaded full PDF and inspected relevant page with pypdf after browser fetch errors. Administrative figures reported by the government, not independent causal evaluation. Rounded rates use separate programme recipient denominators, not population or poverty denominators.

title: 850 Ribu Penerima Penghargaan SARA Belanja Lebih RM50 Juta Pada Hari Pertama
locator: Paragraphs on terminal performance degradation and capacity/maintenance response
evidence_type: Primary programme/public record or institution’s own assessment; relevant passages inspected
appraisal: Official acknowledgement supplies contrary operational evidence. One launch-day incident does not quantify continuing uptime, all failures or later recovery.

title: Ucapan Belanjawan MADANI Kelima Tahun 2027
publisher: Anwar Ibrahim / Ministry of Finance Malaysia
locator: Paragraph 26: STR/SARA RM16bn versus RM15bn; 2027 design
evidence_type: Primary programme/public record or institution’s own assessment; relevant passages inspected
appraisal: Announced budget provision, not realised expenditure or AI-derived revenue. Policy design changes, so equal total labels do not imply identical benefits or coverage.

title: Sumbangan Asas Rahmah: SARA Bulanan and SARA Untuk Semua
publisher: Official SARA programme portal; MyKasih implementation
locator: Introduction, eligibility, cashless MyKad account and approved purchases
evidence_type: Primary programme/public record or institution’s own assessment; relevant passages inspected
appraisal: Operational design source, not a programme impact evaluation. Credits restricted to approved essentials/merchants differ from unrestricted cash. Some dynamic-page wording may be simplified; no detailed category rate chart inferred.

title: OECD Economic Surveys: Malaysia 2026
locator: Executive summary: Growth will moderate but remain solid; revenue and protection discussion
evidence_type: Primary programme/public record or institution’s own assessment; relevant passages inspected
appraisal: Inspected relevant policy assessment, not every chapter. Revenue recommendation is OECD analysis, not a forecast adopted here or proof of UHI infeasibility.
